title: Cinnamon roll cookies 🧸 A cozy and delectable frosted, cinnamon swirl...
description: Cinnamon roll cookies 🧸 A cozy and delectable frosted, cinnamon swirl cookie is a perfect fall treat and will make your kitchen smell heavenly! Ingredients: Cinnamon swirl- 3 tablespoons (42 g) salted butter, softened 70 g brown sugar, packed 2 1/4 tsps cinnamon Cookies- 1/2 cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar 1 large egg, room temperature 1 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 1/2 cups (180 g) all-purpose flour 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 tsp cornstarch heaping 1/4 teaspoon salt Frosting- 2 ounces cream cheese, softened 4 Tablespoons unsalted butter, softened 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon milk or cream, as needed Ground cinnamon, for sprinkling Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 350F. 2. Make the cinnamon swirl first - In a medium bowl, combine the softened butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon until combined. Using a small spoon, scoop small, marble sized dollops of the cinnamon swirl onto a piece of parchment on a plate. Place in the freezer for about 30 mins. 3. Make the cookie dough - In a large bowl, cream together the sugar and butter. Add in the egg and vanilla extract and stir to combine. 4. In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, cornstarch, and salt. Add to the butter mixture and fold until combined. 5. Fold in the cinnamon swirl pieces. 6. Scoop large scoops onto a parchment-lined cookie sheet and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. 7. Bake for about 10-12 mins until the edges are golden. 8. While the cookies cool, make the frosting. Combine the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, vanilla, and milk if needed. 9. Use a piping bag to frost the cookies, or spread with a knife. Sprinkle with ground cinnamon. 10. Enjoy! #fallbaking #cinnamonrollcookies #autumn #fall #cozyvibes
